archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST for clarity

headings.instruction: Use for all page titles, section headers, and product titles.

body.instruction: Use for all paragraphs, UI text, labels, and table data.

mono.instruction: Use for order IDs, invitation codes, wallet addresses, and currency amounts.

public_marketplace.header: Sticky with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60). Must include Logo, Search Bar, Currency/Lang Switcher, Cart, User Profile. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds.
public_marketplace.hero: Hero section with banner image and CTA. Max overlay opacity bg-black/40.
public_marketplace.product_grid: Mobile: 2 columns (grid-cols-2). Tablet: 3 columns (grid-cols-3). Desktop: 4-5 columns. Gap-4 to gap-6.
public_marketplace.footer: Dark footer with generous padding (py-20), multiple columns for links.

dashboards.sidebar: Collapsible left-side navigation. Active states must have high contrast (e.g., bg-primary/10 text-primary border-r-2 border-primary).
dashboards.header: Top header for global actions (notifications, wallet balance, language, profile). Solid background.
dashboards.content_area: Dense padding (p-4 md:p-8). Use high-density grid for metrics cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4).

grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-4 to p-8 for cards. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
grids.bento: For dashboard overview: use mixed span logic. Summary cards col-span-1. Main chart col-span-2 or 3. Feed/list col-span-1 row-span-2.

component_name.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Always animate hover states. ONLY use primary color for primary CTAs.
component_name.tables: Shadcn tables. Left-align text, right-align monetary values. Highlight rows on hover.
component_name.badges: Use for order/KYC statuses. Light background with solid text (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800) for clarity.
component_name.modals: Backdrop blur on overlay. Centered. Clear typography.
component_name.tabs: Override fixed heights like h-9 with h-auto to prevent cutoff.
component_name.inputs: Shadcn inputs. Focus state must have ring-2 and primary color.

visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px borders. Use border-collapse for technical tables/grids.
visual_enhancers.radius: Nested radii (child <= parent). Max 8px for standard cards (rounded-lg).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows for floating elements (modals, dropdowns).

motion.hover: Explicit hover colors (hover:text-primary). Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance for product lists and table rows.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast checking. Normal text 4.5:1, Large 3:1.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid in kebab-case (e.g., add-to-cart-button, login-submit-button).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden for purely decorative elements.

media.icons: lucide-react (default). Use @phosphor-icons/react for high-end look if installed, else lucide-react.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for data-heavy dashboards. Can use minimal Framer Motion for hero interactions on marketplace.

dashboard_placeholders.description: Business meeting for team dashboard placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a hybrid fullstack e-commerce marketplace and multi-store dashboard.
Provide a toggle for Light/Dark themes or default to Light for the marketplace and Light/Dark support for dashboards.
Implement EN/FR/ES language switcher and multi-currency selector.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex marketing/public layouts to ensure freedom, and Shadcn UI components for dashboards and interactive forms.
For tables, calendars, modals, and complex inputs, HEAVILY CUSTOMIZE Shadcn components to remove the default 'Vercel' look. Override borders and radii.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and forms.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds on headers; use glassmorphism with specific blur and background opacity.
Never use `transition: all`. Specify exact transitions (e.g., transform, opacity).
Mobile-first design is critical. Navigation should collapse into a hamburger on mobile, but remain visible on desktop.
Ensure monetary values and order IDs use monospace fonts.
Status badges must be distinct (Success=Green, Warning=Yellow, Error=Red) and clear to read.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`.
